status: NON-EXECUTABLE EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY; not linked to the live site; no image bytes downloaded, reused, pixel-inspected, or bundled.
scope: Ten distinct Wikimedia Commons file-description records: two each for Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia; distinct landmarks within each country.
method: Opened each exact Commons file-description page; checked self-reported own-work source, credited author, depicted subject and stated CC BY-SA 4.0 licence; compared candidates with main's existing Commons registries and the editorial PR's country groups.
releaseRequirements: Before any display: inspect original image pixels and file history, verify licence and third-party architectural/interior/artwork rights for the actual image, confirm subject and geolocation, visibly credit author with exact Commons file page and licence link, note any crops/edits and respect ShareAlike for adaptations. Do not attach photographs of distant sites to capital-centred country gateway pins without clear distinction. Offline photo bytes have not been prepared.
